sections.title: Replace parameterized to_sql() with repr()-based SQL string interpolation
sections.rationale: These hunks remove the parameterized to_sql()/params mechanism and instead build SQL by inlining user-supplied tokens directly into the query string via __repr__.

sections.title: Discard parsed query parameters, leaving qvars empty
sections.rationale: Both call sites stop capturing the parameter dict returned by parser.parse() and set qvars to an empty dict, so the interpolated query string is executed with no bound values.
